probes.question: Hello, I'm Dr Okafor, one of the doctors in this clinic. What's brought you in today?
probes.target: It hurts when we have sex.
probes.credits: Introduced yourself by name and role

probes.question: Take your time and tell me what's been going on, however you'd like to start.
probes.target: OPEN
probes.credits: Let her tell the story in her own words

probes.question: Can you show me or tell me where exactly it hurts?
probes.target: The pain is in your vagina. Say it hurts "on the outside part" and a little "on the inside".

probes.question: What does the pain actually feel like for you?
probes.target: The pain feels like you are being rubbed raw, almost a burning feeling.

probes.question: Does the pain move anywhere else, like into your tummy or your back?
probes.target: It does not spread anywhere else.

probes.question: When did you first notice this?
probes.target: You have always had pain when you have sex. You noticed it when you first started having sex as a teenager, and you thought it would get better, but it never really has.

probes.question: Is it worst when he first goes in, or does it last the whole time, or after you've finished?
probes.target: It is worse when you start having sex, but it carries on the whole time, and you are sore for a few hours afterwards.

probes.question: How strong is the pain? Has it ever been so bad you've had to stop?
probes.target: It is hard to put a number on it. You have never had to stop because of the pain.
probes.credits: How bad the pain is and how it affects her

probes.question: How is all this affecting things between you and your partner?
probes.target: It is affecting your relationship with your boyfriend. He feels bad, because it really hurts.
probes.credits: How bad the pain is and how it affects her

probes.question: Was it the same with people you were with before your current boyfriend?
probes.target: It is the same with your boyfriend as it was with anyone before him.
probes.credits: Whether it happens with every partner

probes.question: Did anything change after you had your little girl?
probes.target: Having the baby made no difference to it. It was the same before and after.
probes.credits: Any change since having the baby

probes.question: Is it any worse around your period?
probes.target: It only happens with sex. It is not worse at any particular time of the month.
probes.credits: Any change with the menstrual cycle

probes.question: Have you found anything that makes it easier, or anything that makes it worse?
probes.target: KY jelly helps at the beginning, but you are still sore at the end. If you put more on it helps, but it is hard to "kill the moment", and your boyfriend feels bad when you use it because he feels like "he isn't doing his job".
probes.credits: What makes it better or worse

probes.question: Does it hurt any less when you're really in the mood?
probes.target: Sometimes it hurts a little less when you are "more into it".

probes.question: Have you noticed any blood after sex?
probes.target: There is no discharge that smells bad. No pain or burning when you pass water. No itching down there. No bleeding after sex.

probes.question: Any unusual discharge, bad smell or itchiness down below?
probes.target: There is no discharge that smells bad. No pain or burning when you pass water. No itching down there. No bleeding after sex.

probes.question: Does it sting when you go to pee?
probes.target: There is no discharge that smells bad. No pain or burning when you pass water. No itching down there. No bleeding after sex.

probes.question: Do you ever get sudden hot flushes or wake up sweaty at night?
probes.target: You have no hot flashes. You feel well in yourself otherwise.

probes.question: Has anyone else checked you over for this recently?
probes.target: You saw your family doctor last week for a well woman check and she said the internal examination was normal. She sent you here.

probes.question: Are you on any regular medicines or pills?
probes.target: You take Zoloft, 25 milligrams every day, for mild depression.

probes.question: What are you using at the moment so you don't get pregnant?
probes.target: You take Loestrin every day for birth control.

probes.question: Are you allergic to anything?
probes.target: You have no allergies to any medicine and no allergies to anything else.

probes.question: How many times have you been pregnant?
probes.target: You have been pregnant twice. You have a daughter aged 3. The other pregnancy was the miscarriage.

probes.question: Have you ever had any women's health problems or procedures, anything done on your womb?
probes.target: You had a miscarriage that did not clear on its own, and they had to do a scrape of the womb.

probes.question: How old were you when you first became sexually active?
probes.target: You were 17 the first time you had sex.

probes.question: Do you sleep with men, women, or both?
probes.target: You have only ever had sex with men.

probes.question: Roughly how many people have you slept with altogether?
probes.target: You have had five men in your life altogether.

probes.question: Are you seeing anyone right now, and how long have you been together?
probes.target: You have been with your boyfriend for four years, and only him.

probes.question: What sort of sex do you two usually have, oral, vaginal, anal?
probes.target: You have oral sex and vaginal sex. You have never had anal sex.
probes.credits: Kinds of sex, oral, vaginal, anal

probes.question: With oral, is that you giving, receiving, or both?
probes.target: You give oral sex, and sometimes you receive it.

probes.question: Are you able to come, or have an orgasm?
probes.target: You have had an orgasm before, so you know you can.

probes.question: How often does that happen for you when you're together?
probes.target: You only get there about one time in five, or less.

probes.question: Do you ever use a vibrator or other toys?
probes.target: You use a vibrator sometimes and that helps you get there. You have never used a dildo.

probes.question: Do you ever pleasure yourself when you're alone?
probes.target: You masturbate sometimes.

probes.question: Do you feel you get wet enough on your own when you're turned on?
probes.target: You do not feel you get wet enough. You use a lubricant sometimes and it does seem to help.

probes.question: How is your sex drive generally? Do you feel like having sex?
probes.target: Your interest in sex is fine. You would call it average.

probes.question: Do you use condoms at all?
probes.target: You used to use condoms. You stopped because you were worried you might be allergic to latex. Now you use them now and again.

probes.question: Have you ever caught an infection from sex?
probes.target: You had trichomonas with your first partner when you were a teenager. Nothing since then.

probes.question: Do you feel safe at home? Has anyone ever hurt you or pushed you into something sexual you didn't want?
probes.target: You feel safe with your boyfriend. Nobody has ever hit you, hurt you or forced you into anything.

probes.question: Who's at home with you, and what do you do for work?
probes.target: You live in a rented two bedroom house in Durham with your boyfriend and your daughter. He is the father.
probes.credits: Social history, work, home, tobacco and alcohol

probes.question: Do you smoke, drink or use any drugs?
probes.target: You have never smoked. You have a drink at special occasions, about one glass a month. No street drugs.
probes.credits: Social history, work, home, tobacco and alcohol

probes.question: Do any illnesses run in your family?
probes.target: Your father is 65 with high blood pressure. Your mother is 62 and had breast cancer at 61, now in remission. Your sister is 35 with type 2 diabetes. Your daughter is 3 and healthy.

probes.question: Have you seen any blisters, sores or lumps down there?
probes.target: NOT IN CASE

probes.question: Any trouble with your bowels, like constipation or pain when you go?
probes.target: NOT IN CASE

probes.question: Have you been feeling unusually tired or cold, or put on weight lately?
probes.target: NOT IN CASE

probes.question: Do you get any aching or swelling in your joints?
probes.target: NOT IN CASE

probes.question: Is there anything else on your mind that we haven't talked about?
probes.target: OPEN
